question: In a certain code language, 'ESCORT' is coded as 'GRBNQV' and 'APRON' is coded as 'COQNP'. What is the code for 'CRANKY' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'ESCORT' is coded as 'GRBNQV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f942a930d676a0e08e4750801058f193dc3b32e8c810453f7a8540d5248f3f57.png] 

For, 'APRON' is coded as 'COQNP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42bad83d06d4f22bb748c0754c1ec51a9151dfdce20bc8eebc7469f90e2dcb59.png] 

Similarly, for '**CRANKY**' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c87a86b7c78d79355b26fda3c35f0eb6d306b387f56335d27c521c1a911b1d56.png] 

So, 'CRANKY' will be related to '**EQZMJA**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
